title: Why Smart People Make Terrible Decisions Under Pressure #Shorts
description:
Smart people fall for this psychological trap every single day.

In this short breakdown, we look at how everyday psychological patterns shape decisions, focus, and reactions.

Key takeaway:
Smart people fall for this psychological trap every single day. When pressure spikes, your brain shifts from rational analysis to threat protection. Instead of finding the best solution, it looks for the fastest relief. That is why overthinking and panic often lead to the exact mistake you feared. Pause for ten seconds, name the emotion, and break the loop.
